method: native-image-reviewed partial body; marching cubes 0.5; no resampling, smoothing or filling
scope: Partial body only, native Y780-860 (about 8 mm). Superior attachment to septal tissue and anterior/posterior cuts are scope limits, not established anatomical boundaries. Crura, columns, fimbria and complete continuity to hippocampus/mammillary body are not represented. Small internal tissue clefts may remain at 0.5 mm sampling. Not expert-reviewed.
